**Chapter 8: Identification of Anodes and Cathodes in Galvanic Cells**

**Table 8.04: Electrode and Reaction**

| Electrode | Reaction |
| --- | --- |
| Zn|Zn²⁺ | Zn(s) → Zn²⁺(aq) + 2e⁻ |
| Cu|Cu²⁺ | Cu(s) → Cu²⁺(aq) + 2e⁻ |
| Fe|Fe²⁺ | Fe(s) → Fe²⁺(aq) + 2e⁻ |
| Ag|Ag⁺ | Ag(s) → Ag⁺(aq) + e⁻ |

**Oxidation half reaction at anode:**

Cu → Cu²⁺ + 2 e⁻

Again, silver ion accepts electron and turns into silver atom.

**Reduction half reaction at cathode:**

2Ag⁺ + 2e⁻ → 2Ag

Adding the two half reactions, we get the total reaction of the cell:

Cu + 2Ag⁺ → Cu²⁺ + 2Ag
